from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for a single company from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="The value of Total Assets reported in the document")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The specific date or period the assets represent (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the assets (e.g., 'USD')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
